-- ### config.ttslua ###
-- AI Controller Configuration
-- Difficulty and settings. Adjust these before starting a game,
-- or use the in-game UI buttons created by ai_main.

Config = {}

local settings = {
    difficulty = "medium",   -- "easy" | "medium" | "hard"
    aiSide     = nil,        -- "red" | "blue" — set at game start via button
    debugMode  = false,      -- if true, prints extra diagnostics to TTS chat
}

function Config.getDifficulty()  return settings.difficulty  end
function Config.getAISide()      return settings.aiSide       end
function Config.isDebug()        return settings.debugMode    end

function Config.setDifficulty(d)
    if d == "easy" or d == "medium" or d == "hard" then
        settings.difficulty = d
        Narrator.announce("AI difficulty set to: " .. d)
    end
end

function Config.setAISide(side)
    if side == "red" or side == "blue" then
        settings.aiSide = side
        Narrator.announce("AI assigned to: " .. side .. " side")
    end
end

function Config.toggleDebug()
    settings.debugMode = not settings.debugMode
    Narrator.announce("Debug mode: " .. (settings.debugMode and "ON" or "OFF"))
end


-- ### systems/narrator.ttslua ###
-- Narrator
-- All AI-to-player communication goes through this module.
-- Announcements are broadcast to all players so the human can follow what the AI is doing.

Narrator = {}

local AI_COLOR  = {r=0.3, g=0.6, b=1.0}   -- light blue text for AI messages
local WARN_COLOR = {r=1.0, g=0.7, b=0.0}  -- amber for warnings

-- Broadcasts a message visible to all players, prefixed with "[AI]".
function Narrator.announce(msg)
    broadcastToAll("[AI] " .. tostring(msg), AI_COLOR)
end

-- Announces a specific action the AI is taking (movement, shooting, etc.).
function Narrator.action(unitName, action, detail)
    local msg = string.format("%s: %s", unitName, action)
    if detail and detail ~= "" then
        msg = msg .. " — " .. detail
    end
    broadcastToAll("[AI] " .. msg, AI_COLOR)
end

-- Announces a dice roll request and its outcome.
function Narrator.rollResult(context, dice, result)
    broadcastToAll(string.format("[AI] %s | %s → %s", context, dice, tostring(result)), AI_COLOR)
end

-- Announces a warning (e.g. no legal targets, missing datasheet entry).
function Narrator.warn(msg)
    broadcastToAll("[AI WARNING] " .. tostring(msg), WARN_COLOR)
end

-- Announces phase start.
function Narrator.phaseStart(phaseName, round)
    broadcastToAll(string.format("[AI] ── Round %d: %s Phase ──", round, phaseName), AI_COLOR)
end

-- Announces end of AI turn.
function Narrator.turnEnd(round)
    broadcastToAll(string.format("[AI] Turn %d complete. Your move.", round), AI_COLOR)
end


-- ### core/ftc_interface.ttslua ###
-- FTC Mod Integration Layer
-- All communication with the FTC mod goes through this file via GUID-based calls.
-- GUIDs are sourced from FTC's global.ttslua. If FTC updates its GUIDs, update here.

FTCInterface = {}

-- GUIDs from FTC global.ttslua — values are the Global variable names FTC uses to store them.
local GUIDS = {
    redVPCounter    = "redVPCounter_GUID",
    blueVPCounter   = "blueVPCounter_GUID",
    redCPCounter    = "redCPCounter_GUID",
    blueCPCounter   = "blueCPCounter_GUID",
    redTurnCounter  = "redTurnCounter_GUID",
    blueTurnCounter = "blueTurnCounter_GUID",
    gameTurnCounter = "gameTurnCounter_GUID",
    redDiceRoller   = "redDiceRoller_GUID",
    blueDiceRoller  = "blueDiceRoller_GUID",
    redDiceMat      = "redDiceMat_GUID",
    blueDiceMat     = "blueDiceMat_GUID",
    startMenu       = "startMenu_GUID",
}

-- Resolved object cache to avoid repeated GUID lookups per frame
local _cache = {}

local function getObj(guidKey)
    if _cache[guidKey] then return _cache[guidKey] end
    local varName = GUIDS[guidKey]
    if not varName then return nil end
    -- FTC stores GUIDs as global variable names; resolve them at runtime
    local guid = Global.getVar(varName)
    if not guid then return nil end
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if obj then _cache[guidKey] = obj end
    return obj
end

-- Flush cache when FTC reloads
function FTCInterface.flushCache()
    _cache = {}
end

-- Scans all objects on the table to locate FTC objects not in the GUID table
-- (score sheet, mission managers). Called once at startup.
function FTCInterface.discoverExtras()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if not obj.isValid() then goto continue end

        -- Score sheet: identified by its scoreData variable
        if not _cache["scoreSheet"] then
            local ok, val = pcall(function() return obj.getVar("scoreData") end)
            if ok and val ~= nil then
                _cache["scoreSheet"] = obj
            end
        end

        -- Start menu fallback: identified by currentPhase variable
        if not _cache["startMenu"] then
            local ok2, phase = pcall(function() return obj.getVar("currentPhase") end)
            if ok2 and phase ~= nil then
                _cache["startMenu"] = obj
            end
        end

        ::continue::
    end
end

-- ── Phase / Round ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FTCInterface.getGamePhase()
    local menu = getObj("startMenu")
    if not menu then return "unknown" end
    return (menu.getVar("currentPhase") or "unknown"):lower()
end

function FTCInterface.getGameRound()
    local obj = getObj("gameTurnCounter")
    if not obj then return 1 end
    return obj.Counter.getValue()
end

-- ── Victory Points ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FTCInterface.getVP(side)
    local key = (side == "red") and "redVPCounter" or "blueVPCounter"
    local obj = getObj(key)
    return obj and obj.Counter.getValue() or 0
end

function FTCInterface.addVP(side, amount)
    local key = (side == "red") and "redVPCounter" or "blueVPCounter"
    local obj = getObj(key)
    if not obj then return end
    obj.Counter.setValue(obj.Counter.getValue() + (amount or 1))
end

-- ── Command Points ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FTCInterface.getCP(side)
    local key = (side == "red") and "redCPCounter" or "blueCPCounter"
    local obj = getObj(key)
    return obj and obj.Counter.getValue() or 0
end

function FTCInterface.spendCP(side, amount)
    local key = (side == "red") and "redCPCounter" or "blueCPCounter"
    local obj = getObj(key)
    if not obj then return false end
    local current = obj.Counter.getValue()
    if current < amount then return false end
    obj.Counter.setValue(current - amount)
    return true
end

function FTCInterface.gainCP(side, amount)
    local key = (side == "red") and "redCPCounter" or "blueCPCounter"
    local obj = getObj(key)
    if not obj then return end
    obj.Counter.setValue(obj.Counter.getValue() + (amount or 1))
end

-- ── Activation Tokens ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- FTC uses "setAlredyActed" (note the typo in FTC source — preserved here for compatibility)
function FTCInterface.setUnitActivated(unitObj)
    if not unitObj then return end
    pcall(function() unitObj.call("setAlredyActed") end)
    unitObj.setVar("alreadyActed", true)
end

function FTCInterface.resetUnitActivation(unitObj)
    if not unitObj then return end
    pcall(function() unitObj.call("resetAlredyActed") end)
    unitObj.setVar("alreadyActed", false)
end

function FTCInterface.isUnitActivated(unitObj)
    if not unitObj then return true end
    return unitObj.getVar("alreadyActed") == true
end

-- ── Wounds ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FTCInterface.getUnitWounds(unitObj)
    if not unitObj then return 0 end
    return unitObj.getVar("wounds") or 0
end

function FTCInterface.modifyUnitWounds(unitObj, delta)
    if not unitObj then return end
    local current = unitObj.getVar("wounds") or 0
    unitObj.setVar("wounds", math.max(0, current + delta))
    pcall(function() unitObj.call("writeMenu") end)
end

-- ── Dice ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FTCInterface.getDiceRoller(side)
    return getObj((side == "red") and "redDiceRoller" or "blueDiceRoller")
end

function FTCInterface.getDiceMat(side)
    return getObj((side == "red") and "redDiceMat" or "blueDiceMat")
end

-- Alias used by game_state.ttslua
function FTCInterface.getCurrentPhaseName()
    return FTCInterface.getGamePhase()
end

-- ── Phase Advance / End Turn ────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Presses the FTC phase-advance button on behalf of the AI player.
-- This is the same as the human clicking "End Phase" or "End Turn".
function FTCInterface.advancePhase(side)
    local menu = getObj("startMenu")
    if not menu then return end
    -- FTC's passTurn function accepts a player color string
    local color = (side == "red") and "Red" or "Blue"
    pcall(function() menu.call("passTurn", {color = color}) end)
end

-- ── Score Sheet ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Clicks a +1 on the FTC 10e score sheet.
-- round: 1-5, category: 1=Primary 2=Secondary1 3=Secondary2, detail: sub-column index
function FTCInterface.scoreSheetPlus(round, category, detail)
    local sheet = getObj("scoreSheet")
    if not sheet then return end
    local fn = string.format("plus_%d%d%d", round, category, detail)
    pcall(function() sheet.call(fn, {}) end)
end

function FTCInterface.scoreSheetMinus(round, category, detail)
    local sheet = getObj("scoreSheet")
    if not sheet then return end
    local fn = string.format("minus_%d%d%d", round, category, detail)
    pcall(function() sheet.call(fn, {}) end)
end

-- ── Mission / Secondary Cards ────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- AI selects its two secondary mission cards.
-- Pass two TTS object references (the card objects in the AI's hand zone).
-- Flips them face-down then calls FTC's lock-in function.
function FTCInterface.lockInSecondaries(side, card1, card2)
    if card1 then pcall(function() card1.flip() end) end
    if card2 then pcall(function() card2.flip() end) end

    Wait.frames(function()
        -- FTC mission manager objects carry a 'missionSide' variable
        for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
            local ok, ms = pcall(function() return obj.getVar("missionSide") end)
            if ok and ms then
                local matchSide = (side == "red") and "Red" or "Blue"
                if ms == matchSide or ms == side then
                    pcall(function() obj.call("lockInSecondaries", {}) end)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end, 3)
end

-- ── FTC Physical Dice Rolling ────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Rolls dice using the FTC physical dice roller for the given side.
-- count: number of d6 to roll
-- onComplete(results): callback receiving a table of integer results
-- Falls back to math.random if the FTC roller is not available.
function FTCInterface.rollPhysicalD6(side, count, onComplete)
    local mat    = getObj((side == "red") and "redDiceMat" or "blueDiceMat")
    local roller = getObj((side == "red") and "redDiceRoller" or "blueDiceRoller")

    if not mat or not roller then
        -- No FTC roller found — use virtual rolls
        local results = {}
        for i = 1, count do results[i] = math.random(1, 6) end
        if onComplete then onComplete(results) end
        return
    end

    -- Use quickRoll if available (returns results immediately without animation)
    local quickOk = pcall(function()
        mat.call("quickRoll", {n = count, player = side})
    end)

    if not quickOk then
        -- Fall back to placing dice in the roller bag and triggering a roll
        pcall(function() roller.call("RollOrSelectDice", {count = count}) end)
    end

    -- Wait for dice physics to settle, then read results from the mat's lastRolls table
    Wait.time(function()
        local results = {}
        local ok, rolls = pcall(function() return mat.getVar("lastRolls") end)
        if ok and rolls and type(rolls) == "table" then
            for _, entry in ipairs(rolls) do
                if entry.value then table.insert(results, entry.value) end
            end
        end
        -- Pad with math.random if fewer results than expected
        while #results < count do
            table.insert(results, math.random(1, 6))
        end
        if onComplete then onComplete(results) end
    end, 2.5)
end

-- Board State Tracker
-- Maintains a live snapshot of all unit positions, objective locations,
-- distances between units, and engagement range status.

BoardState = {}

-- Objective marker positions are read once at game start from objects tagged
-- with 'objectiveMarker' in their GM notes or description.
local objectives     = {}   -- list of {id, pos, controlledBy}
local unitPositions  = {}   -- guid -> {pos, side, engaged}

local ENGAGEMENT_RANGE_INCHES = 1.0  -- 1" engagement range in 40K 10e
local TTS_UNITS_PER_INCH      = 2.54 -- TTS world units to inches conversion

local function ttsToInches(ttsDistance)
    return ttsDistance / TTS_UNITS_PER_INCH
end

local function distance3d(a, b)
    local dx = a.x - b.x
    local dy = a.y - b.y
    local dz = a.z - b.z
    return math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz)
end

-- Horizontal distance only (ignores Y height) — used for range/movement checks.
local function distanceXZ(a, b)
    local dx = a.x - b.x
    local dz = a.z - b.z
    return math.sqrt(dx*dx + dz*dz)
end

function BoardState.distanceInches(posA, posB)
    return ttsToInches(distanceXZ(posA, posB))
end

-- Rebuild objective list by scanning all objects for objective markers.
function BoardState.scanObjectives()
    objectives = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local notes = obj.getGMNotes() or ""
        local desc  = obj.getDescription() or ""
        if notes:find("objectiveMarker") or desc:find("objectiveMarker") or
           obj.getName():lower():find("objective") then
            table.insert(objectives, {
                id          = obj.getGUID(),
                obj         = obj,
                pos         = obj.getPosition(),
                controlledBy = nil,
            })
        end
    end
    return objectives
end

function BoardState.getObjectives()
    return objectives
end

-- Updates the position cache for a single unit.
function BoardState.updateUnit(guid, pos, side)
    unitPositions[guid] = { pos = pos, side = side, engaged = false }
end

function BoardState.removeUnit(guid)
    unitPositions[guid] = nil
end

-- Recalculates engagement flags for all tracked units.
-- A unit is engaged if any enemy model is within ENGAGEMENT_RANGE_INCHES.
function BoardState.recalcEngagement(aiUnits, enemyUnits)
    -- Clear flags
    for guid, _ in pairs(unitPositions) do
        unitPositions[guid].engaged = false
    end

    for _, aiUnit in ipairs(aiUnits or {}) do
        local aiPos = aiUnit.obj and aiUnit.obj.getPosition()
        if aiPos then
            for _, enemyUnit in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
                local ePos = enemyUnit.obj and enemyUnit.obj.getPosition()
                if ePos then
                    local dist = ttsToInches(distanceXZ(aiPos, ePos))
                    if dist <= ENGAGEMENT_RANGE_INCHES then
                        local guid = aiUnit.obj.getGUID()
                        if unitPositions[guid] then
                            unitPositions[guid].engaged = true
                        end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function BoardState.isEngaged(guid)
    return unitPositions[guid] and unitPositions[guid].engaged or false
end

-- Returns sorted list of objectives by distance from a given position.
function BoardState.objectivesByDistance(pos)
    local sorted = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(objectives) do
        local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, obj.pos)
        table.insert(sorted, { objective = obj, distance = dist })
    end
    table.sort(sorted, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)
    return sorted
end

-- Returns the closest enemy unit to a given position.
function BoardState.closestEnemy(pos, enemyUnits)
    local closest, minDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, unit in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
        if unit.obj then
            local d = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, unit.obj.getPosition())
            if d < minDist then
                minDist = d
                closest = unit
            end
        end
    end
    return closest, minDist
end

-- Updates objective control by checking which side has higher total OC within 3".
function BoardState.updateObjectiveControl(aiUnits, enemyUnits, aiSide)
    local CONTROL_RANGE = 3.0
    for _, objective in ipairs(objectives) do
        local aiOC, enemyOC = 0, 0
        for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits or {}) do
            if unit.obj then
                local d = BoardState.distanceInches(objective.pos, unit.obj.getPosition())
                if d <= CONTROL_RANGE then
                    aiOC = aiOC + (unit.stats and unit.stats.OC or 1)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, unit in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
            if unit.obj then
                local d = BoardState.distanceInches(objective.pos, unit.obj.getPosition())
                if d <= CONTROL_RANGE then
                    enemyOC = enemyOC + (unit.stats and unit.stats.OC or 1)
                end
            end
        end

        if aiOC > enemyOC then
            objective.controlledBy = aiSide
        elseif enemyOC > aiOC then
            objective.controlledBy = (aiSide == "red") and "blue" or "red"
        else
            objective.controlledBy = nil  -- contested
        end
    end
end

-- Returns count of objectives currently controlled by the given side.
function BoardState.objectivesControlledBy(side)
    local count = 0
    for _, obj in ipairs(objectives) do
        if obj.controlledBy == side then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count
end

-- Case-insensitive lookup with partial match fallback.
function DatasheetDB.lookup(name)
    if not name or name == "" then return nil end
    local key = name:lower():gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

    -- Exact match
    if db[key] then return db[key] end

    -- Partial match: return first entry whose key is contained in the name or vice versa
    for dbKey, stats in pairs(db) do
        if key:find(dbKey, 1, true) or dbKey:find(key, 1, true) then
            return stats
        end
    end

    return nil
end

-- Returns all known unit names (useful for diagnostics).
function DatasheetDB.allNames()
    local names = {}
    for k, _ in pairs(db) do table.insert(names, k) end
    table.sort(names)
    return names
end

-- Unit Tracker
-- Creates and maintains per-unit state records.
-- Each record wraps a TTS object with game-relevant metadata resolved from the datasheet DB.

UnitTracker = {}

-- Creates a unit record for the given TTS object.
-- Matches the object name to a datasheet entry to populate stats.
function UnitTracker.createRecord(obj, side)
    if not obj or not obj.isValid() then return nil end

    local name  = obj.getName() or ""
    local guid  = obj.getGUID()
    local stats = DatasheetDB.lookup(name)

    -- Object has no matching name and no wounds counter — likely a token or terrain piece.
    if not stats and not obj.getVar("wounds") then
        return nil
    end

    local wounds = obj.getVar("wounds") or (stats and stats.W or 1)

    return {
        guid        = guid,
        obj         = obj,
        name        = name,
        side        = side,
        stats       = stats or UnitTracker.defaultStats(),
        currentW    = wounds,
        activated   = FTCInterface.isUnitActivated(obj),
        inReserve   = false,
        battleShocked = false,
    }
end

function UnitTracker.defaultStats()
    return { M=6, T=4, W=1, SV=4, INSV=6, LD=7, OC=1,
             weapons = {},
             keywords = {},
             abilities = {} }
end

-- Syncs the record's wound count and activation state from the live TTS object.
function UnitTracker.refresh(record)
    if not record or not record.obj or not record.obj.isValid() then return end
    record.currentW  = FTCInterface.getUnitWounds(record.obj)
    record.activated = FTCInterface.isUnitActivated(record.obj)
end

-- Returns true if the unit has been destroyed (wounds ≤ 0 or object gone).
function UnitTracker.isDestroyed(record)
    if not record.obj or not record.obj.isValid() then return true end
    return record.currentW <= 0
end

-- Applies damage to a record and its live TTS object.
function UnitTracker.applyWounds(record, damage)
    record.currentW = math.max(0, record.currentW - damage)
    FTCInterface.modifyUnitWounds(record.obj, -damage)
    if UnitTracker.isDestroyed(record) then
        Narrator.announce(string.format("[AI] %s has been destroyed!", record.name))
        ArmyManager.removeUnit(record.guid)
    end
end

-- Marks unit as having acted this phase and updates the FTC activation token.
function UnitTracker.markActivated(record)
    record.activated = true
    FTCInterface.setUnitActivated(record.obj)
end

-- Resets activation at the start of a new round.
function UnitTracker.resetActivation(record)
    record.activated   = false
    record.battleShocked = false
    FTCInterface.resetUnitActivation(record.obj)
end

-- Returns true if unit can still act this phase.
function UnitTracker.canAct(record)
    return not record.activated and not record.inReserve and not UnitTracker.isDestroyed(record)
end

-- Returns the unit's best ranged weapon (highest expected damage per attack).
function UnitTracker.bestRangedWeapon(record)
    local best, bestScore = nil, -1
    for _, w in ipairs(record.stats.weapons or {}) do
        if w.type == "ranged" then
            local score = (w.A or 1) * (w.D or 1) * (1 / math.max(w.AP or 0 + 1, 1))
            if score > bestScore then bestScore = score; best = w end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- Returns the unit's best melee weapon.
function UnitTracker.bestMeleeWeapon(record)
    local best, bestScore = nil, -1
    for _, w in ipairs(record.stats.weapons or {}) do
        if w.type == "melee" then
            local score = (w.A or 1) * (w.D or 1) * (1 / math.max(w.AP or 0 + 1, 1))
            if score > bestScore then bestScore = score; best = w end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- Returns true if this unit is melee-optimised (best weapon is melee or has MELEE keyword).
function UnitTracker.isMeleeUnit(record)
    local hasKeyword = false
    for _, kw in ipairs(record.stats.keywords or {}) do
        if kw:upper() == "MELEE" then hasKeyword = true; break end
    end
    local meleeW  = UnitTracker.bestMeleeWeapon(record)
    local rangedW = UnitTracker.bestRangedWeapon(record)
    if hasKeyword then return true end
    if meleeW and not rangedW then return true end
    if meleeW and rangedW then
        local ms = (meleeW.A or 1) * (meleeW.D or 1)
        local rs = (rangedW.A or 1) * (rangedW.D or 1)
        return ms > rs
    end
    return false
end

-- Returns true if this unit has the FIGHTS FIRST ability.
function UnitTracker.hasFightsFirst(record)
    for _, ab in ipairs(record.stats.abilities or {}) do
        if ab:upper():find("FIGHTS FIRST") then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- Army Manager
-- Detects which army belongs to the AI by scanning the table at game start.
-- Detection is purely spatial: models on the AI's assigned table half are its army.
-- Uses the YellowScribe army mat (BCBtype == 'armyMat') as the primary anchor.

ArmyManager = {}

-- Z > 0 is the Red deployment half; Z < 0 is Blue.
local SIDE_Z = { red = 1, blue = -1 }
local ARMY_MAT_SCAN_RADIUS = 80   -- TTS units; wide enough to catch all units near the mat
local DEPLOY_HALF_THRESHOLD = 0   -- Z == 0 is centreline

local aiSide       = nil
local aiUnits      = {}   -- list of UnitTracker unit records
local enemyUnits   = {}

local function isOnSide(pos, side)
    if side == "red"  then return pos.z >  DEPLOY_HALF_THRESHOLD end
    if side == "blue" then return pos.z <  DEPLOY_HALF_THRESHOLD end
    return false
end

-- Identifies the YellowScribe army mat for the given side.
local function findArmyMat(side)
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local bcbtype = obj.getVar("BCBtype")
        if bcbtype == "armyMat" then
            local pos = obj.getPosition()
            if isOnSide(pos, side) then
                return obj
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Collects all non-terrain objects on the AI's side of the table.
-- Excludes FTC tool objects (identified by GM notes tags).
local function collectUnitsOnSide(side)
    local units = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local pos   = obj.getPosition()
        local notes = obj.getGMNotes() or ""
        local name  = obj.getName() or ""

        -- Skip FTC infrastructure objects
        if notes:find("FTC_TOOL") or notes:find("objectiveMarker") or
           notes:find("terrain") or name == "" then
            goto continue
        end

        -- Skip non-physical objects (zones, scripting triggers, etc.)
        local objType = obj.type or ""
        if objType == "Scripting" or objType == "Fog" or objType == "Hand" then
            goto continue
        end

        if isOnSide(pos, side) then
            local bcbtype = obj.getVar("BCBtype")
            -- Skip the army mat itself; it's not a unit
            if bcbtype ~= "armyMat" then
                table.insert(units, obj)
            end
        end
        ::continue::
    end
    return units
end

function ArmyManager.init(assignedSide)
    aiSide    = assignedSide
    aiUnits   = {}
    enemyUnits = {}

    local enemySide = (assignedSide == "red") and "blue" or "red"

    -- Verify army mat exists on our side
    local mat = findArmyMat(assignedSide)
    if not mat then
        Narrator.announce("[AI] Warning: No army mat found on " .. assignedSide .. " side. "
            .. "Ensure the YellowScribe army is placed before starting.")
    else
        Narrator.announce("[AI] Army mat found on " .. assignedSide .. " side.")
    end

    -- Collect all objects on each side and wrap them in UnitTracker records
    local aiObjs    = collectUnitsOnSide(assignedSide)
    local enemyObjs = collectUnitsOnSide(enemySide)

    for _, obj in ipairs(aiObjs) do
        local record = UnitTracker.createRecord(obj, assignedSide)
        if record then table.insert(aiUnits, record) end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(enemyObjs) do
        local record = UnitTracker.createRecord(obj, enemySide)
        if record then table.insert(enemyUnits, record) end
    end

    Narrator.announce(string.format("[AI] Detected %d AI units and %d enemy units.",
        #aiUnits, #enemyUnits))

    -- Seed board state positions
    for _, u in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        BoardState.updateUnit(u.guid, u.obj.getPosition(), assignedSide)
    end
    for _, u in ipairs(enemyUnits) do
        BoardState.updateUnit(u.guid, u.obj.getPosition(), enemySide)
    end

    -- Scan for objective markers
    BoardState.scanObjectives()

    -- Initialise reserves (units not yet on table start in reserve pool if tagged)
    ReserveManager.init(aiUnits)

    -- Hand off side info to GameState
    GameState.init(assignedSide)

    return #aiUnits > 0
end

function ArmyManager.getAISide()     return aiSide     end
function ArmyManager.getAIUnits()    return aiUnits    end
function ArmyManager.getEnemyUnits() return enemyUnits end

-- Remove a destroyed unit from the active list and board state.
function ArmyManager.removeUnit(guid)
    for i, u in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        if u.guid == guid then
            table.remove(aiUnits, i)
            BoardState.removeUnit(guid)
            return
        end
    end
    for i, u in ipairs(enemyUnits) do
        if u.guid == guid then
            table.remove(enemyUnits, i)
            BoardState.removeUnit(guid)
            return
        end
    end
end

-- Refreshes positions of all tracked units (called at start of each phase).
function ArmyManager.refreshPositions()
    for _, u in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        if u.obj and u.obj.isValid() then
            BoardState.updateUnit(u.guid, u.obj.getPosition(), aiSide)
        end
    end
    for _, u in ipairs(enemyUnits) do
        if u.obj and u.obj.isValid() then
            local enemySide = (aiSide == "red") and "blue" or "red"
            BoardState.updateUnit(u.guid, u.obj.getPosition(), enemySide)
        end
    end
    BoardState.recalcEngagement(aiUnits, enemyUnits)
    BoardState.updateObjectiveControl(aiUnits, enemyUnits, aiSide)
end

-- Dice Handler
-- Resolves all combat dice rolls for the AI.
--
-- Two modes (toggled via Config.usePhysicalDice):
--   false (default): math.random — instant, no animation.
--   true           : FTC physical dice roller — dice actually roll on the table
--                    so the human player can watch and verify results.
--                    Combat resolution becomes asynchronous (callback-based).

DiceHandler = {}

math.randomseed(os.time())

-- Whether to use FTC's physical dice roller or virtual math.random rolls.
-- Changed at runtime via DiceHandler.setPhysical(bool).
local usePhysical = false
local pendingSide = "blue"   -- AI's side, set when physical mode is used

function DiceHandler.setPhysical(flag, side)
    usePhysical = flag == true
    pendingSide = side or "blue"
end

function DiceHandler.isPhysical()
    return usePhysical
end

-- Rolls n dice with f faces. Returns a table of individual results and the sum.
local function rollDice(n, faces)
    local results, total = {}, 0
    for i = 1, n do
        local r = math.random(1, faces)
        table.insert(results, r)
        total = total + r
    end
    return results, total
end

-- Parses an attack count that may be a fixed number, "D6", "2D6", "D3", etc.
local function resolveCount(val)
    if type(val) == "number" then return val end
    if type(val) == "string" then
        local mult, sides = val:match("(%d*)D(%d+)")
        if sides then
            local n = tonumber(mult) or 1
            local _, total = rollDice(n, tonumber(sides))
            return total
        end
    end
    return 1
end

-- Resolves a single damage value (may be dice notation).
local function resolveDamage(val)
    return resolveCount(val)
end

-- Core attack resolution: returns wounds dealt to the target.
-- weapon: datasheet weapon table
-- targetStats: target's T, SV, INSV fields
-- numModels: number of models in the attacking unit contributing this weapon
function DiceHandler.resolveAttack(weapon, targetStats, numModels, difficulty)
    difficulty = difficulty or Config.getDifficulty()

    local attacks  = resolveCount(weapon.A) * (numModels or 1)
    local hitRoll  = weapon.BS or weapon.WS or 4
    local strength = weapon.S or 4
    local ap       = weapon.AP or 0
    local damage   = weapon.D or 1

    -- ── Hit rolls ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local hits = 0
    local hitResults = {}
    for i = 1, attacks do
        local r = math.random(1, 6)
        table.insert(hitResults, r)
        local threshold = hitRoll
        if difficulty == "easy" then threshold = threshold + 1 end
        if r >= threshold then hits = hits + 1 end
        -- Critical hit (natural 6) generates a Lethal Hit if weapon has LETHAL HITS
        if r == 6 and weapon.special and weapon.special:find("LETHAL HITS") then
            hits = hits  -- counted above; lethal hits auto-wound handled below
        end
    end

    -- TORRENT weapons auto-hit
    if weapon.special and weapon.special:find("TORRENT") then
        hits = attacks
    end

    -- ── Wound rolls ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local toughness = targetStats.T or 4
    local woundThreshold
    if strength >= toughness * 2 then      woundThreshold = 2
    elseif strength > toughness then       woundThreshold = 3
    elseif strength == toughness then      woundThreshold = 4
    elseif strength * 2 <= toughness then  woundThreshold = 6
    else                                   woundThreshold = 5
    end

    local wounds = 0
    for i = 1, hits do
        local r = math.random(1, 6)
        if r >= woundThreshold then wounds = wounds + 1 end
        -- DEVASTATING WOUNDS: natural 6 to wound = mortal wound (bypass save)
        if r == 6 and weapon.special and weapon.special:find("DEVASTATING WOUNDS") then
            wounds = wounds  -- will bypass saves below
        end
    end

    -- ── Save rolls ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local sv    = targetStats.SV or 4
    local invsv = targetStats.INSV or 0
    local modSv = sv + ap  -- higher AP (negative) makes saves harder

    -- Use best save available
    local effectiveSave = modSv
    if invsv > 0 and invsv < modSv then effectiveSave = invsv end
    -- Cap at 7 (auto-fail) and floor at 2 (natural 1 always fails handled below)
    effectiveSave = math.min(effectiveSave, 7)

    local unsaved = 0
    for i = 1, wounds do
        local r = math.random(1, 6)
        -- Natural 1 always fails saves
        if r == 1 or r < effectiveSave then
            unsaved = unsaved + 1
        end
    end

    -- ── Damage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local totalDamage = 0
    for i = 1, unsaved do
        totalDamage = totalDamage + resolveDamage(damage)
    end

    -- MELTA bonus damage within half range is already factored into weapon D value
    -- by the caller supplying the correct weapon profile.

    return totalDamage, {
        attacks = attacks,
        hits    = hits,
        wounds  = wounds,
        unsaved = unsaved,
        damage  = totalDamage,
    }
end

-- Rolls 2D6 for a charge and returns the total.
function DiceHandler.chargeRoll()
    local results, total = rollDice(2, 6)
    return total, results
end

-- Rolls a single D6 for a battle-shock test against leadership.
-- Returns true if the test is passed (roll ≥ LD).
function DiceHandler.battleShockTest(ld)

    return r >= ld, r
end

-- Rolls D6 for morale/ability triggers.
function DiceHandler.d6()
    return math.random(1, 6)
end

function DiceHandler.d3()
    return math.random(1, 3)
end

function DiceHandler.twod6()

-- ── Physical dice wrapper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Async version of resolveAttack for use when usePhysical == true.
-- Rolls dice in stages on the FTC dice mat, calling onComplete(damage, breakdown)
-- when all three roll stages (hit / wound / save) are finished.
function DiceHandler.resolveAttackPhysical(weapon, targetStats, numModels, onComplete)
    local difficulty = Config.getDifficulty()
    local side       = pendingSide

    local attacks  = resolveCount(weapon.A) * (numModels or 1)
    local hitRoll  = weapon.BS or weapon.WS or 4
    local strength = weapon.S or 4
    local ap       = weapon.AP or 0
    local damage   = weapon.D or 1

    -- TORRENT: auto-hit — skip hit roll entirely
    if weapon.special and weapon.special:find("TORRENT") then
        local hits = attacks
        DiceHandler._physicalWoundStage(hits, strength, ap, damage, targetStats,
            difficulty, weapon, side, onComplete)
        return
    end

    -- Stage 1: Hit rolls
    Narrator.rollResult("Hit rolls", string.format("%dD6 (BS%d+)", attacks, hitRoll), "rolling…")
    FTCInterface.rollPhysicalD6(side, attacks, function(hitResults)
        local hits = 0
        for _, r in ipairs(hitResults) do
            local threshold = hitRoll
            if difficulty == "easy" then threshold = threshold + 1 end
            if r >= threshold then hits = hits + 1 end
        end
        Narrator.rollResult("Hit rolls", table.concat(hitResults, ","), hits .. " hits")

        DiceHandler._physicalWoundStage(hits, strength, ap, damage, targetStats,
            difficulty, weapon, side, onComplete)
    end)
end

function DiceHandler._physicalWoundStage(hits, strength, ap, damage, targetStats, difficulty, weapon, side, onComplete)
    if hits == 0 then
        if onComplete then onComplete(0, {hits=0, wounds=0, unsaved=0, damage=0}) end
        return
    end

    local toughness = targetStats.T or 4
    local woundThreshold
    if strength >= toughness * 2 then      woundThreshold = 2
    elseif strength > toughness then       woundThreshold = 3
    elseif strength == toughness then      woundThreshold = 4
    elseif strength * 2 <= toughness then  woundThreshold = 6
    else                                   woundThreshold = 5
    end

    -- Stage 2: Wound rolls
    Narrator.rollResult("Wound rolls", string.format("%dD6 (S%d vs T%d)", hits, strength, toughness), "rolling…")
    FTCInterface.rollPhysicalD6(side, hits, function(woundResults)
        local wounds = 0
        for _, r in ipairs(woundResults) do
            if r >= woundThreshold then wounds = wounds + 1 end
        end
        Narrator.rollResult("Wound rolls", table.concat(woundResults, ","), wounds .. " wounds")

        DiceHandler._physicalSaveStage(wounds, ap, damage, targetStats, weapon, side, onComplete, hits)
    end)
end

function DiceHandler._physicalSaveStage(wounds, ap, damage, targetStats, weapon, side, onComplete, hits)
    if wounds == 0 then
        if onComplete then onComplete(0, {hits=hits, wounds=0, unsaved=0, damage=0}) end
        return
    end

    local sv    = targetStats.SV or 4
    local invsv = targetStats.INSV or 0
    local modSv = sv + ap
    if invsv > 0 and invsv < modSv then modSv = invsv end
    modSv = math.min(modSv, 7)

    -- Stage 3: Save rolls (for the defender — we roll on the AI mat still for speed)
    Narrator.rollResult("Save rolls", string.format("%dD6 (SV%d+)", wounds, modSv), "rolling…")
    FTCInterface.rollPhysicalD6(side, wounds, function(saveResults)
        local unsaved = 0
        for _, r in ipairs(saveResults) do
            if r == 1 or r < modSv then unsaved = unsaved + 1 end
        end
        Narrator.rollResult("Save rolls", table.concat(saveResults, ","), unsaved .. " unsaved")

        local totalDamage = 0
        for i = 1, unsaved do
            totalDamage = totalDamage + resolveCount(damage)
        end
        if onComplete then
            onComplete(totalDamage, {hits=hits, wounds=wounds, unsaved=unsaved, damage=totalDamage})
        end
    end)
end

-- Convenience: call either sync or async resolveAttack based on mode.
-- onComplete is only used when usePhysical == true.
function DiceHandler.resolve(weapon, targetStats, numModels, onComplete)
    if usePhysical then
        DiceHandler.resolveAttackPhysical(weapon, targetStats, numModels, onComplete)
    else
        local dmg, breakdown = DiceHandler.resolveAttack(weapon, targetStats, numModels)
        if onComplete then onComplete(dmg, breakdown) end
    end
end

-- Reserve Manager
-- Tracks units in Strategic Reserve and manages their arrival on the battlefield.
-- 40K 10e rules: reserves can arrive from round 2 onward, placed anywhere on the
-- battlefield edge or (for Deep Strike) anywhere >9" from enemy models.

ReserveManager = {}

local DEEP_STRIKE_CLEARANCE = 9.0    -- inches from nearest enemy
local BOARD_EDGE_INSET      = 1.0    -- inches from table edge for arrival

local reservePool   = {}   -- list of UnitTracker records currently in reserve
local currentRound  = 1

-- Board edge arrival zones (approximate TTS world coordinates).
-- Adjust these to match the actual FTC battlefield layout.
local BOARD = {
    minX = -22, maxX = 22,   -- 44" wide board
    minZ = -30, maxZ = 30,   -- 60" long board (Strike Force)
}

local function edgePositions(side)
    -- Returns candidate arrival positions along the AI's board edge.
    if side == "blue" then
        -- Blue deploys at negative Z; their edge is the far negative Z end
        local positions = {}
        for x = BOARD.minX, BOARD.maxX, 4 do
            table.insert(positions, {x=x, y=1.5, z=BOARD.minZ + BOARD_EDGE_INSET})
        end
        return positions
    else
        local positions = {}
        for x = BOARD.minX, BOARD.maxX, 4 do
            table.insert(positions, {x=x, y=1.5, z=BOARD.maxZ - BOARD_EDGE_INSET})
        end
        return positions
    end
end

-- Returns true if a position is ≥9" from all enemy models (for Deep Strike).
local function clearOfEnemies(pos, enemyUnits)
    for _, unit in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
        if unit.obj and unit.obj.isValid() then
            local d = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, unit.obj.getPosition())
            if d < DEEP_STRIKE_CLEARANCE then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end

-- Finds the best Deep Strike position near a target objective.
local function bestDeepStrikePosition(objective, enemyUnits, aiSide)
    -- Try candidate positions in a ring around the objective at 10-12" range
    local objPos = objective.pos
    local candidates = {}
    for angle = 0, 360, 30 do
        local rad  = math.rad(angle)
        local dist = 10  -- 10" from objective, safely outside 9" clearance from nearby enemy
        local pos  = { x = objPos.x + dist * math.cos(rad),
                       y = 1.5,
                       z = objPos.z + dist * math.sin(rad) }
        -- Clamp to board
        pos.x = math.max(BOARD.minX, math.min(BOARD.maxX, pos.x))
        pos.z = math.max(BOARD.minZ, math.min(BOARD.maxZ, pos.z))
        if clearOfEnemies(pos, enemyUnits) then
            table.insert(candidates, pos)
        end
    end
    if #candidates > 0 then return candidates[1] end
    return nil
end

function ReserveManager.init(aiUnits)
    reservePool  = {}
    currentRound = 1
    -- Units tagged DEEP STRIKE or placed in reserve zone start in reserve.
    for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits or {}) do
        local hasDeepStrike = false
        for _, kw in ipairs(unit.stats and unit.stats.keywords or {}) do
            if kw:upper() == "DEEP STRIKE" then hasDeepStrike = true; break end
        end
        for _, ab in ipairs(unit.stats and unit.stats.abilities or {}) do
            if ab:upper():find("DEEP STRIKE") then hasDeepStrike = true; break end
        end
        if hasDeepStrike then
            unit.inReserve      = true
            unit.hasDeepStrike  = true
            -- Move model off-board (high Y) so it doesn't block gameplay
            if unit.obj and unit.obj.isValid() then
                unit.obj.setPosition({x=50, y=5, z=50})
                unit.obj.setLock(true)
            end
            table.insert(reservePool, unit)
            Narrator.announce(string.format("%s placed in Strategic Reserve (Deep Strike).", unit.name))
        end
    end
end

function ReserveManager.onNewRound(round)
    currentRound = round
end

-- Returns true if the AI should deploy a specific reserve unit this turn.
-- Simple heuristic: deploy in round 2 if objectives are contested; else round 3.
local function shouldDeployNow(unit)
    if currentRound < 2 then return false end
    local aiControlled = BoardState.objectivesControlledBy(ArmyManager.getAISide())
    if currentRound == 2 and aiControlled < 2 then return true end
    if currentRound >= 3 then return true end
    return false
end

-- Deploys all reserve units that are ready to arrive.
function ReserveManager.deployReady(aiSide, enemyUnits)
    if #reservePool == 0 then return end

    local objectives = BoardState.getObjectives()
    local arrivals   = {}

    for i = #reservePool, 1, -1 do
        local unit = reservePool[i]
        if shouldDeployNow(unit) then
            local pos = nil

            if unit.hasDeepStrike then
                -- Find the best uncontrolled objective to Deep Strike near
                for _, obj in ipairs(objectives) do
                    if obj.controlledBy ~= aiSide then
                        pos = bestDeepStrikePosition(obj, enemyUnits, aiSide)
                        if pos then break end
                    end
                end
                -- Fallback: any clear position near board centre
                if not pos then
                    local centre = {x=0, y=1.5, z=0}
                    if clearOfEnemies(centre, enemyUnits) then pos = centre end
                end
            else
                -- Standard Strategic Reserve: arrive from board edge
                local edges = edgePositions(aiSide)
                for _, ep in ipairs(edges) do
                    if clearOfEnemies(ep, enemyUnits) then pos = ep; break end
                end
            end

            if pos then
                unit.obj.setLock(false)
                unit.obj.setPositionSmooth(pos)
                unit.inReserve = false
                Narrator.action(unit.name, "arrives from reserve",
                    string.format("deploying at (%.1f, %.1f)", pos.x, pos.z))
                table.remove(reservePool, i)
                table.insert(arrivals, unit)
            else
                Narrator.warn(string.format("%s has no valid arrival position this round.", unit.name))
            end
        end
    end

    return arrivals
end

function ReserveManager.getReservePool()
    return reservePool
end

function ReserveManager.addToReserve(unit)
    unit.inReserve = true
    if unit.obj and unit.obj.isValid() then
        unit.obj.setPosition({x=50, y=5, z=50})
        unit.obj.setLock(true)
    end
    table.insert(reservePool, unit)
end


-- ### systems/objective_tracker.ttslua ###
-- Objective Tracker
-- Scores and prioritises objectives for the AI each turn.
-- Works with BoardState's control calculations to determine scoring opportunities.

ObjectiveTracker = {}

-- Returns a priority-sorted list of objectives the AI should contest or hold.
-- Higher score = higher priority for AI attention.
function ObjectiveTracker.prioritised(aiSide)
    local objectives = BoardState.getObjectives()
    local aiUnits    = ArmyManager.getAIUnits()
    local scored     = {}

    for _, obj in ipairs(objectives) do
        local score = 0

        -- Unclaimed or enemy-held objectives are high priority
        if obj.controlledBy == nil then
            score = score + 10
        elseif obj.controlledBy ~= aiSide then
            score = score + 15   -- enemy-held is most valuable to contest
        else
            score = score + 3    -- already holding; maintain but lower priority
        end

        -- Closer objectives (to AI units) are more actionable
        local minDist = math.huge
        for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits) do
            if unit.obj and unit.obj.isValid() and not unit.inReserve then
                local d = BoardState.distanceInches(obj.pos, unit.obj.getPosition())
                if d < minDist then minDist = d end
            end
        end
        -- Discount by distance: objectives we can reach this turn score higher
        if minDist < math.huge then
            score = score + math.max(0, 20 - minDist)
        end

        table.insert(scored, { objective = obj, score = score, distance = minDist })
    end

    table.sort(scored, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
    return scored
end

-- Returns total VPs the AI would score if it held its current objectives.
function ObjectiveTracker.estimateVPGain(aiSide)
    local count = BoardState.objectivesControlledBy(aiSide)
    -- Rough estimate: 4 VP per held objective per round (matches 10e primary scoring)
    return count * 4
end

-- Called at the end of the AI's Command Phase to score primary objectives.
-- Adds VP to the FTC counter for each objective the AI controls.
function ObjectiveTracker.scoreObjectives(aiSide)
    local count  = BoardState.objectivesControlledBy(aiSide)
    if count == 0 then return end
    local vp = count * 4
    FTCInterface.addVP(aiSide, vp)
    Narrator.announce(string.format("Scoring %d VP from %d objective(s).", vp, count))
end

-- Threat Assessment
-- Scores enemy units by how dangerous they are to the AI.
-- Used by the decision engine to prioritise targets.

ThreatAssessment = {}

-- Computes an expected damage-per-round score for an enemy unit against average AI targets.
-- Higher score = more threatening = higher kill priority.
local function expectedDamage(enemyUnit)
    local stats = enemyUnit.stats
    if not stats then return 1 end

    local totalScore = 0
    for _, w in ipairs(stats.weapons or {}) do
        local attacks = tonumber(w.A) or 2
        local hitChance  = math.max(0, (7 - (w.BS or w.WS or 4))) / 6
        local woundChance
        local s = w.S or 4
        local t = 4   -- assume average AI toughness 4
        if s >= t * 2 then     woundChance = 5/6
        elseif s > t then      woundChance = 4/6
        elseif s == t then     woundChance = 3/6
        elseif s * 2 <= t then woundChance = 1/6
        else                   woundChance = 2/6
        end

        local saveChance = math.max(0, math.min(5, (4 + (w.AP or 0)) - 1)) / 6
        local unsavedChance = 1 - saveChance
        local dmg = tonumber(w.D) or 1

        totalScore = totalScore + attacks * hitChance * woundChance * unsavedChance * dmg
    end

    -- Bonus for high-value targets: Characters and big models
    for _, kw in ipairs(stats.keywords or {}) do
        if kw:upper() == "CHARACTER" then totalScore = totalScore * 1.3 end
        if kw:upper() == "VEHICLE"   then totalScore = totalScore * 1.1 end
        if kw:upper() == "MONSTER"   then totalScore = totalScore * 1.1 end
    end

    return totalScore
end

-- Scores a target for shooting priority.
-- Balances threat level with how killable the unit is right now.
function ThreatAssessment.shootingPriority(enemyUnit, shooterPos)
    local stats = enemyUnit.stats or {}
    local pos   = enemyUnit.obj and enemyUnit.obj.getPosition()
    if not pos then return 0 end

    local dist   = BoardState.distanceInches(shooterPos, pos)
    local threat = expectedDamage(enemyUnit)

    -- Efficiency: prefer nearly-dead units (spend fewer attacks to kill)
    local hpRatio = (enemyUnit.currentW or 1) / math.max(stats.W or 1, 1)
    local killEfficiency = 1 / math.max(hpRatio, 0.1)

    -- Proximity: closer threats are more urgent
    local proximityBonus = math.max(0, 30 - dist) / 30

    return threat * killEfficiency * (1 + proximityBonus)
end

-- Scores a target for melee charge priority.
function ThreatAssessment.chargePriority(enemyUnit, chargerPos, chargerStats)
    local pos = enemyUnit.obj and enemyUnit.obj.getPosition()
    if not pos then return 0 end

    local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(chargerPos, pos)
    if dist > 12 then return 0 end   -- outside maximum 2D6 charge range

    local threat   = expectedDamage(enemyUnit)
    local chargeOK = (dist <= 7) and 1.0 or 0.4   -- >7" charge is unreliable on 2D6

    -- Prefer charging melee-dangerous enemies before they shoot us
    local meleeThreat = 0
    for _, w in ipairs((enemyUnit.stats or {}).weapons or {}) do
        if w.type == "melee" then
            meleeThreat = meleeThreat + ((w.A or 1) * (w.D or 1))
        end
    end

    -- Prefer isolating enemy from objectives
    local objControl = BoardState.objectivesControlledBy((ArmyManager.getAISide() == "red") and "blue" or "red")
    local objectivePressure = objControl > 0 and 1.2 or 1.0

    return threat * chargeOK * objectivePressure
end

-- Returns the enemy unit list sorted by shooting priority from a given position.
function ThreatAssessment.sortedByShootingPriority(enemyUnits, shooterPos)
    local scored = {}
    for _, u in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
        if u.obj and u.obj.isValid() and not u.inReserve then
            local score = ThreatAssessment.shootingPriority(u, shooterPos)
            table.insert(scored, { unit = u, score = score })
        end
    end
    table.sort(scored, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
    return scored
end

-- Returns the enemy unit list sorted by charge priority from a given position.
function ThreatAssessment.sortedByChargePriority(enemyUnits, chargerPos, chargerStats)
    local scored = {}
    for _, u in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
        if u.obj and u.obj.isValid() and not u.inReserve then
            local score = ThreatAssessment.chargePriority(u, chargerPos, chargerStats)
            if score > 0 then
                table.insert(scored, { unit = u, score = score })
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(scored, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
    return scored
end


-- ### ai/decision_engine.ttslua ###
-- Decision Engine
-- Heuristic scoring engine for all AI decisions.
-- Each phase calls into this module to select the best action for each unit.

DecisionEngine = {}

local DIFFICULTY_MODIFIERS = {
    easy   = { targetPriority = 0.5, advanceChance = 0.4, chargeChance = 0.5 },
    medium = { targetPriority = 0.8, advanceChance = 0.6, chargeChance = 0.7 },
    hard   = { targetPriority = 1.0, advanceChance = 0.8, chargeChance = 0.85 },
}

local function mod()
    return DIFFICULTY_MODIFIERS[Config.getDifficulty()] or DIFFICULTY_MODIFIERS.medium
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- MOVEMENT DECISIONS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Returns the best destination position for a unit during the Movement phase.
-- Balances: moving onto objectives, advancing toward enemies, staying in cover.
function DecisionEngine.bestMoveTarget(unit, enemyUnits)
    local pos   = unit.obj.getPosition()
    local stats = unit.stats or {}
    local moveIn = stats.M or 6
    local isMelee = UnitTracker.isMeleeUnit(unit)

    -- Score each objective as a movement destination
    local objPriority = ObjectiveTracker.prioritised(ArmyManager.getAISide())
    local best, bestScore = nil, -math.huge

    for _, entry in ipairs(objPriority) do
        local objPos = entry.objective.pos
        local dist   = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, objPos)

        -- Can we reach this objective?
        local reachable = dist <= moveIn
        -- Would advancing (move + D6") let us reach it?
        local advanceReach = dist <= (moveIn + 6)

        if reachable or advanceReach then
            local score = entry.score

            -- Melee units want to get close to enemies
            if isMelee then
                local closest, eDist = BoardState.closestEnemy(objPos, enemyUnits)
                if eDist < 8 then score = score * 1.5 end
            end

            -- Penalty for moving into engagement range when we're a ranged unit
            if not isMelee then
                local _, eDist = BoardState.closestEnemy(objPos, enemyUnits)
                if eDist and eDist < 2 then score = score * 0.2 end
            end

            if score > bestScore then
                bestScore = score
                best = {
                    pos     = objPos,
                    advance = not reachable and advanceReach,
                    dist    = dist,
                }
            end
        end
    end

    -- If no objective is reachable, move toward the highest-threat enemy (melee)
    -- or hold position (ranged with no better option).
    if not best then
        if isMelee then
            local closest, eDist = BoardState.closestEnemy(pos, enemyUnits)
            if closest and closest.obj then
                best = { pos = closest.obj.getPosition(), advance = false, dist = eDist }
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

-- Decides if advancing is worthwhile (add D6" to movement, but cannot shoot afterwards).
function DecisionEngine.shouldAdvance(unit, destination)
    if not destination then return false end
    local isMelee = UnitTracker.isMeleeUnit(unit)
    -- Melee units advance aggressively; ranged units only advance if they have no targets
    if isMelee then
        return destination.advance and math.random() < mod().advanceChance
    end
    return destination.advance and math.random() < 0.25
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SHOOTING DECISIONS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Returns the best shooting target and weapon for a given unit.
function DecisionEngine.bestShootingTarget(unit, enemyUnits)
    local weapon  = UnitTracker.bestRangedWeapon(unit)
    if not weapon then return nil, nil end

    local pos = unit.obj.getPosition()
    local prioritised = ThreatAssessment.sortedByShootingPriority(enemyUnits, pos)

    for _, entry in ipairs(prioritised) do
        local target = entry.unit
        local tPos   = target.obj.getPosition()
        local dist   = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, tPos)

        -- Range check
        if weapon.R and dist > weapon.R then goto continue end

        -- Cannot shoot into or out of engagement range with another unit
        if BoardState.isEngaged(unit.guid) then goto continue end

        -- Difficulty modifier: easier = AI may skip best target
        if math.random() > mod().targetPriority then goto continue end

        return target, weapon
        ::continue::
    end
    return nil, nil
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- CHARGE DECISIONS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Returns the best charge target for a unit, or nil if charging isn't advisable.
function DecisionEngine.bestChargeTarget(unit, enemyUnits)
    if not UnitTracker.isMeleeUnit(unit) then return nil end

    local pos      = unit.obj.getPosition()
    local priority = ThreatAssessment.sortedByChargePriority(enemyUnits, pos, unit.stats)

    for _, entry in ipairs(priority) do
        local target = entry.unit
        local tPos   = target.obj.getPosition()
        local dist   = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, tPos)

        -- Only charge if we have a meaningful probability (dist ≤ 7" = 58%+ on 2D6)
        local chargeProb = dist <= 7 and mod().chargeChance or (mod().chargeChance * 0.4)
        if math.random() < chargeProb then
            return target
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- FIGHT DECISIONS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Returns the best melee target within engagement range.
function DecisionEngine.bestFightTarget(unit, enemyUnits)
    local weapon = UnitTracker.bestMeleeWeapon(unit)
    if not weapon then return nil, nil end

    local pos    = unit.obj.getPosition()
    local best, bestScore = nil, -math.huge

    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
        if enemy.obj and enemy.obj.isValid() then
            local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, enemy.obj.getPosition())
            if dist <= 1.0 then   -- within 1" engagement range
                local score = ThreatAssessment.shootingPriority(enemy, pos)
                if score > bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    best = enemy
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best, weapon
end

-- Returns units sorted so FIGHTS FIRST units go before others.
function DecisionEngine.fightOrder(aiUnits)
    local first, normal = {}, {}
    for _, u in ipairs(aiUnits or {}) do
        if UnitTracker.canAct(u) and not u.inReserve then
            if UnitTracker.hasFightsFirst(u) then
                table.insert(first, u)
            else
                table.insert(normal, u)
            end
        end
    end
    -- Concatenate: fights-first units go at the front
    local ordered = {}
    for _, u in ipairs(first)  do table.insert(ordered, u) end
    for _, u in ipairs(normal) do table.insert(ordered, u) end
    return ordered
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- CONSOLIDATION DECISIONS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Returns the best consolidation destination (up to 3" move after fighting).
-- Prioritises moving onto objectives or tagging additional enemies.
function DecisionEngine.bestConsolidation(unit, enemyUnits)
    local pos  = unit.obj.getPosition()
    local best = nil
    local bestScore = -math.huge

    -- Check nearby objectives
    for _, entry in ipairs(ObjectiveTracker.prioritised(ArmyManager.getAISide())) do
        local oPos = entry.objective.pos
        local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, oPos)
        if dist <= 3 then
            local score = entry.score + 5  -- bonus for stepping onto objective
            if score > bestScore then bestScore = score; best = oPos end
        end
    end

    -- Check nearby enemies to tag (keep them locked in combat)
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemyUnits or {}) do
        if enemy.obj and enemy.obj.isValid() then
            local eDist = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, enemy.obj.getPosition())
            if eDist > 1 and eDist <= 3 then
                local score = 8  -- tagging enemy is valuable
                if score > bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    best = enemy.obj.getPosition()
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end
