-- Command Phase Handler
-- Executes the AI's Command Phase:
--   1. Score primary objectives (VP gain)
--   2. Gain Command Points (FTC CP counter)
--   3. Resolve Battle-shock tests for units that lost models last round
--   4. Reset activation tokens on all AI units
--   5. Evaluate any Command Phase stratagems

CommandPhase = {}

function CommandPhase.execute(aiSide, round)
    Narrator.phaseStart("Command", round)
    ArmyManager.refreshPositions()

    local aiUnits = ArmyManager.getAIUnits()

    -- ── 1. Score primary objectives ──────────────────────────────────────
    ObjectiveTracker.scoreObjectives(aiSide)

    -- ── 2. Gain CP ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- In 10e each player gains CP each Command Phase (variable by mission).
    -- Default gain is 1 CP per round; some missions give more.
    local cpGain = 1
    FTCInterface.gainCP(aiSide, cpGain)
    StratagemManager.syncCP(aiSide)
    Narrator.announce(string.format("Gained %d CP. Total CP: %d", cpGain, StratagemManager.getCP()))

    -- ── 3. Battle-shock tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        if unit.battleShocked then
            local passed, roll = DiceHandler.battleShockTest(unit.stats and unit.stats.LD or 7)
            if passed then
                unit.battleShocked = false
                Narrator.action(unit.name, "passes Battle-shock test", string.format("rolled %d", roll))
            else
                Narrator.action(unit.name, "fails Battle-shock test",
                    string.format("rolled %d vs LD %d — unit cannot use special abilities this round",
                    roll, unit.stats and unit.stats.LD or 7))
            end
        end
    end

    -- ── 4. Reset activation tokens ───────────────────────────────────────
    for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        UnitTracker.resetActivation(unit)
    end
    Narrator.announce("All AI activation tokens reset.")

    -- ── 5. Deploy any reserves that should arrive via Rapid Ingress ──────
    -- (Standard reserve deployment happens in the Movement Phase;
    --  Rapid Ingress is used in opponent's movement phase, handled reactively.)

    Narrator.announce("Command Phase complete.")
    -- Press FTC's phase-advance button so the game progresses to Movement Phase.
    Wait.time(function() FTCInterface.advancePhase(aiSide) end, 0.5)
end


-- ### phases/movement_phase.ttslua ###
-- Movement Phase Handler
-- Executes the AI's Movement Phase:
--   1. Deploy Strategic Reserve units (arrive from round 2)
--   2. Move each non-reserve, non-activated unit to its best destination
--   3. Announce Advance moves (unit cannot shoot after advancing)
-- Coherency: multi-model units should stay within 2" chain — the AI moves
-- the unit leader to the destination and the remainder follow within 2".

MovementPhase = {}

local ADVANCE_ROLL_FACES = 6   -- D6 advance roll

local function advanceRoll()
    return math.random(1, ADVANCE_ROLL_FACES)
end

-- Moves a single unit object smoothly to the destination position.
-- offsetIndex staggers units slightly so they don't stack exactly.
local function moveUnit(unit, destPos, offsetIndex)
    if not unit.obj or not unit.obj.isValid() then return end
    local offset = offsetIndex or 0
    local pos = {
        x = destPos.x + (offset % 3) * 1.2,
        y = destPos.y or 1.5,
        z = destPos.z + math.floor(offset / 3) * 1.2,
    }
    unit.obj.setPositionSmooth(pos)
    BoardState.updateUnit(unit.guid, pos, ArmyManager.getAISide())
end

function MovementPhase.execute(aiSide, round)
    Narrator.phaseStart("Movement", round)
    ArmyManager.refreshPositions()

    local aiUnits    = ArmyManager.getAIUnits()
    local enemyUnits = ArmyManager.getEnemyUnits()

    -- ── 1. Deploy reserves ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    local arrived = ReserveManager.deployReady(aiSide, enemyUnits)
    -- Newly arrived units are not activated (they move from reserve as their move action)
    for _, unit in ipairs(arrived or {}) do
        UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)
    end

    -- ── 2. Move on-table units ────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Small delay between each move so TTS can animate smoothly.
    local moveIndex = 0
    for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        if not UnitTracker.canAct(unit) then goto continue end
        if unit.inReserve then goto continue end

        local dest = DecisionEngine.bestMoveTarget(unit, enemyUnits)
        if not dest then
            Narrator.action(unit.name, "holds position", "no beneficial move found")
            UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)
            goto continue
        end

        local advanced   = false
        local moveInches = unit.stats and unit.stats.M or 6

        if DecisionEngine.shouldAdvance(unit, dest) then
            local advBonus = advanceRoll()
            moveInches = moveInches + advBonus
            advanced   = true
            Narrator.action(unit.name, string.format("Advances %d\"", moveInches),
                string.format("(Move %d\" + Advance +%d\")", unit.stats and unit.stats.M or 6, advBonus))
            unit.advanced = true
        else
            unit.advanced = false
            Narrator.action(unit.name, string.format("Moves %d\"", moveInches))
        end

        -- Scale destination: if it's further than moveInches, stop partway.
        local pos  = unit.obj.getPosition()
        local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, dest.pos)
        if dist > moveInches then
            -- Move directly toward destination, capped at moveInches
            local ratio = moveInches / dist
            dest.pos = {
                x = pos.x + (dest.pos.x - pos.x) * ratio,
                y = pos.y,
                z = pos.z + (dest.pos.z - pos.z) * ratio,
            }
        end

        moveUnit(unit, dest.pos, moveIndex)
        moveIndex = moveIndex + 1
        UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)

        ::continue::
    end

    -- Refresh positions after all moves settle, then advance to Shooting Phase.
    Wait.time(function()
        ArmyManager.refreshPositions()
        Narrator.announce("Movement Phase complete.")
        Wait.time(function() FTCInterface.advancePhase(aiSide) end, 0.5)
    end, 2.0)
end


-- ### phases/shooting_phase.ttslua ###
-- Shooting Phase Handler
-- Executes the AI's Shooting Phase:
--   1. Each non-engaged, non-activated, non-advanced unit selects a target
--   2. Resolves attack dice (virtual rolls via DiceHandler)
--   3. Applies wounds to target, announces damage
--   4. Marks unit as activated after shooting

ShootingPhase = {}

function ShootingPhase.execute(aiSide, round)
    Narrator.phaseStart("Shooting", round)
    ArmyManager.refreshPositions()

    local aiUnits    = ArmyManager.getAIUnits()
    local enemyUnits = ArmyManager.getEnemyUnits()

    for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        -- Skip units that can't shoot
        if unit.activated                     then goto continue end
        if unit.inReserve                     then goto continue end
        if unit.advanced                      then goto continue end   -- advanced units can't shoot
        if BoardState.isEngaged(unit.guid)    then goto continue end   -- engaged units can't shoot

        local target, weapon = DecisionEngine.bestShootingTarget(unit, enemyUnits)
        if not target or not weapon then
            Narrator.action(unit.name, "has no valid shooting target")
            UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)
            goto continue
        end

        local pos     = unit.obj.getPosition()
        local tPos    = target.obj.getPosition()
        local dist    = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, tPos)
        local numMini = 1   -- simplified: treat each record as one model (extend for unit sizes)

        -- Check MELTA: if weapon has MELTA and target is within half range, upgrade damage
        local effectiveWeapon = weapon
        if weapon.special and weapon.special:find("MELTA") then
            local meltaBonus = tonumber(weapon.special:match("MELTA (%d+)")) or 2
            if dist <= (weapon.R or 0) / 2 then
                effectiveWeapon = {}
                for k, v in pairs(weapon) do effectiveWeapon[k] = v end
                local baseDmg = tonumber(effectiveWeapon.D) or 1
                effectiveWeapon.D = baseDmg + meltaBonus
            end
        end

        -- Use DiceHandler.resolve: async when physical dice enabled, sync otherwise.
        -- Capture loop vars for the callback closure.
        local capturedUnit   = unit
        local capturedTarget = target
        local capturedWeapon = effectiveWeapon
        local capturedSide   = aiSide

        DiceHandler.resolve(effectiveWeapon, target.stats or {}, numMini, function(damage, breakdown)
            Narrator.action(capturedUnit.name,
                string.format("shoots %s with %s", capturedTarget.name, capturedWeapon.name),
                string.format("%d attacks → %d hits → %d wounds → %d unsaved → %d damage",
                    breakdown.attacks, breakdown.hits, breakdown.wounds, breakdown.unsaved, breakdown.damage))

            if damage > 0 then
                UnitTracker.applyWounds(capturedTarget, damage)
            end

            StratagemManager.evaluateAutoUse("shooting", {
                infantryUnderHeavyFire = damage >= 3,
                infantryUnitAvailable  = true,
            }, capturedSide)
        end)

        UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)
        ::continue::
    end

    Narrator.announce("Shooting Phase complete.")
    Wait.time(function() FTCInterface.advancePhase(aiSide) end, 0.5)
end


-- ### phases/charge_phase.ttslua ###
-- Charge Phase Handler
-- Executes the AI's Charge Phase per 40K 10th edition rules:
--
--   For each eligible melee unit (not activated, not in reserve):
--     1. Declare charge against the best target(s)
--     2. Roll 2D6 charge distance
--     3. If roll ≥ distance to target: move unit into base contact (1")
--        If roll < distance: charge fails, unit stays put
--     4. Evaluate Heroic Intervention and Overwatch stratagems for the enemy
--     5. Mark unit activated after resolving charge
--
-- Units that Advanced this turn may not charge.
-- A unit can declare a charge against multiple targets (charge roll must meet
-- the shortest distance to any declared target).

ChargePhase = {}

-- Minimum distance the charging unit's base must end up from the target.
local CHARGE_END_RANGE = 1.0   -- inches (base contact)

-- Moves the charging unit to just within 1" of the target.
local function moveToEngagement(charger, target)
    if not charger.obj or not target.obj then return end
    local cPos = charger.obj.getPosition()
    local tPos = target.obj.getPosition()
    local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(cPos, tPos)
    if dist <= CHARGE_END_RANGE then return end  -- already in range

    -- Place the charger 1" away from the target along the line between them.
    local ratio = (dist - CHARGE_END_RANGE) / dist
    local dest = {
        x = cPos.x + (tPos.x - cPos.x) * (1 - ratio),
        y = cPos.y,
        z = cPos.z + (tPos.z - cPos.z) * (1 - ratio),
    }
    charger.obj.setPositionSmooth(dest)
    BoardState.updateUnit(charger.guid, dest, ArmyManager.getAISide())
end

function ChargePhase.execute(aiSide, round)
    Narrator.phaseStart("Charge", round)
    ArmyManager.refreshPositions()

    local aiUnits    = ArmyManager.getAIUnits()
    local enemyUnits = ArmyManager.getEnemyUnits()

    for _, unit in ipairs(aiUnits) do
        -- Eligibility checks
        if unit.activated                  then goto continue end
        if unit.inReserve                  then goto continue end
        if unit.advanced                   then goto continue end   -- cannot charge after Advancing
        if not UnitTracker.isMeleeUnit(unit) then goto continue end -- skip non-melee units

        local pos    = unit.obj.getPosition()
        local target = DecisionEngine.bestChargeTarget(unit, enemyUnits)

        if not target or not target.obj then
            Narrator.action(unit.name, "does not charge", "no viable target in range")
            UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)
            goto continue
        end

        local tPos = target.obj.getPosition()
        local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, tPos)

        -- Declare the charge
        Narrator.action(unit.name,
            string.format("declares charge against %s", target.name),
            string.format("%.1f\" away", dist))

        -- Evaluate Overwatch stratagem for the defender
        StratagemManager.evaluateAutoUse("charge", {
            enemyCharged           = true,
            chargerThreatensKeyUnit = (target.stats and target.stats.W and target.stats.W >= 4),
            unitWithin6            = false,  -- Heroic Intervention handled separately
        }, aiSide)

        -- Roll 2D6 charge distance
        local roll, results = DiceHandler.chargeRoll()
        Narrator.rollResult(
            string.format("%s charge roll", unit.name),
            string.format("2D6 (%d+%d)", results[1], results[2]),
            roll
        )

        if roll >= math.ceil(dist) then
            -- Charge succeeds
            moveToEngagement(unit, target)
            Narrator.action(unit.name, "CHARGE SUCCESSFUL",
                string.format("rolled %d, needed %d — now engaged with %s", roll, math.ceil(dist), target.name))

            -- Evaluate Heroic Intervention for nearby enemy units
            StratagemManager.evaluateAutoUse("charge", {
                enemyCharged   = true,
                unitWithin6    = true,
                chargerThreatensKeyUnit = false,
            }, aiSide)
        else
            -- Charge fails; unit stays where it is
            Narrator.action(unit.name, "CHARGE FAILED",
                string.format("rolled %d, needed %d — unit halts", roll, math.ceil(dist)))
        end

        UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)
        ::continue::
    end

    -- Refresh engagement flags after all charges resolve, then advance to Fight Phase.
    Wait.time(function()
        ArmyManager.refreshPositions()
        Narrator.announce("Charge Phase complete.")
        Wait.time(function() FTCInterface.advancePhase(aiSide) end, 0.5)
    end, 1.5)
end


-- ### phases/fight_phase.ttslua ###
-- Fight Phase Handler
-- Executes the AI's Fight Phase per 40K 10th edition rules:
--
--   Fight sequence:
--     1. All units with FIGHTS FIRST fight before any other units
--     2. Remaining eligible units fight in an alternating sequence with the opponent
--        (AI fights, opponent fights, AI fights, etc. — simplified: AI fights all eligible)
--     3. For each fighting unit:
--        a. Pile-in move: move up to 3" toward the nearest enemy to get more models in range
--        b. Select best melee target within 1" engagement range
--        c. Resolve melee attack dice
--        d. Apply wounds to target
--        e. Consolidate: move up to 3" to contest an objective or tag another enemy
--     4. Mark unit activated after fighting
--
-- Casualty removal: enemy models are removed from the back of their unit
-- (furthest models from the AI unit fight first) to preserve coherency.

FightPhase = {}

local PILE_IN_RANGE       = 3.0   -- max pile-in move in inches
local CONSOLIDATION_RANGE = 3.0   -- max consolidation move in inches
local ENGAGEMENT_RANGE    = 1.0   -- units within 1" can fight

-- Moves a unit up to maxInches toward a target position.
local function moveToward(unit, targetPos, maxInches, label)
    if not unit.obj or not unit.obj.isValid() then return end
    local pos  = unit.obj.getPosition()
    local dist = BoardState.distanceInches(pos, targetPos)
    if dist < 0.1 then return end  -- already there

    local move = math.min(dist, maxInches)
    local ratio = move / dist
    local dest  = {
        x = pos.x + (targetPos.x - pos.x) * ratio,
        y = pos.y,
        z = pos.z + (targetPos.z - pos.z) * ratio,
    }
    unit.obj.setPositionSmooth(dest)
    BoardState.updateUnit(unit.guid, dest, ArmyManager.getAISide())
    if label then
        Narrator.action(unit.name, label, string.format("%.1f\"", move))
    end
end

-- Resolves one unit's fight: pile-in → attack → consolidate.
local function fightWithUnit(unit, enemyUnits, aiSide)
    local pos = unit.obj.getPosition()

    -- ── Pile-in ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Move up to 3" toward the nearest enemy model to maximise models in range.
    local nearest, nDist = BoardState.closestEnemy(pos, enemyUnits)
    if nearest and nearest.obj and nDist > ENGAGEMENT_RANGE then
        moveToward(unit, nearest.obj.getPosition(), PILE_IN_RANGE, "piles in")
        pos = unit.obj.getPosition()   -- update after pile-in
    end

    -- ── Select fight target ────────────────────────────────────────────
    local target, weapon = DecisionEngine.bestFightTarget(unit, enemyUnits)
    if not target or not weapon then
        Narrator.action(unit.name, "no enemies in engagement range — cannot fight")
        return
    end

    -- ── Resolve melee attacks ──────────────────────────────────────────
    local numMini        = 1
    local capturedUnit   = unit
    local capturedTarget = target
    local capturedWeapon = weapon

    DiceHandler.resolve(weapon, target.stats or {}, numMini, function(damage, breakdown)
        Narrator.action(capturedUnit.name,
            string.format("fights %s with %s", capturedTarget.name, capturedWeapon.name),
            string.format("%d attacks → %d hits → %d wounds → %d unsaved → %d damage",
                breakdown.attacks, breakdown.hits, breakdown.wounds, breakdown.unsaved, breakdown.damage))

        if damage > 0 then
            UnitTracker.applyWounds(capturedTarget, damage)
        end
    end)

    -- ── Counter-Offensive stratagem window ────────────────────────────
    StratagemManager.evaluateAutoUse("fight", {
        enemyJustFought    = false,   -- this is AI fighting; CO fires when enemy fights
        hasMeleeUnitInRange = false,
    }, aiSide)

    -- ── Consolidation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    -- Move up to 3" after fighting: prefer stepping onto an objective,
    -- or tagging an additional enemy unit to lock them in combat.
    local consoleDest = DecisionEngine.bestConsolidation(unit, enemyUnits)
    if consoleDest then
        moveToward(unit, consoleDest, CONSOLIDATION_RANGE, "consolidates")
    end
end

function FightPhase.execute(aiSide, round)
    Narrator.phaseStart("Fight", round)
    ArmyManager.refreshPositions()

    local enemyUnits = ArmyManager.getEnemyUnits()

    -- Build fight order: FIGHTS FIRST units go before all others.
    local ordered = DecisionEngine.fightOrder(ArmyManager.getAIUnits())

    if #ordered == 0 then
        Narrator.announce("No AI units eligible to fight.")
        Narrator.announce("Fight Phase complete.")
        return
    end

    -- Fight each unit in sequence (pile-in → attack → consolidate).
    for _, unit in ipairs(ordered) do
        local pos  = unit.obj.getPosition()
        local near = BoardState.closestEnemy(pos, enemyUnits)
        local _, nDist = BoardState.closestEnemy(pos, enemyUnits)

        -- A unit can only fight if it is within ENGAGEMENT_RANGE of an enemy,
        -- or it charged this turn (it moved into engagement range already).
        if nDist and nDist <= (ENGAGEMENT_RANGE + PILE_IN_RANGE) then
            fightWithUnit(unit, enemyUnits, aiSide)
        else
            Narrator.action(unit.name, "not in engagement range — skipping")
        end

        UnitTracker.markActivated(unit)
    end

    -- Final position refresh after all fights, then advance (ends the AI's full turn).
    Wait.time(function()
        ArmyManager.refreshPositions()
        BoardState.recalcEngagement(ArmyManager.getAIUnits(), ArmyManager.getEnemyUnits())
        Narrator.turnEnd(round)
        Wait.time(function() FTCInterface.advancePhase(aiSide) end, 0.5)
    end, 2.0)
end


-- ### core/game_state.ttslua ###
-- Game State Reader
-- Polls FTC for phase/round changes and dispatches to AI phase handlers.
-- Uses Wait.time polling since FTC has no event subscription system.

GameState = {}

local PHASES = {"command", "movement", "shooting", "charge", "fight"}
local POLL_INTERVAL = 1.5  -- seconds between phase checks

local state = {
    currentPhase  = nil,
    currentRound  = 0,
    aiSide        = nil,   -- "red" or "blue", set by ArmyManager on load
    aiTurnActive  = false,
    phaseHandled  = false,
    lastRound     = 0,
}

-- Called by ai_main after army detection completes.
function GameState.init(aiSide)
    state.aiSide       = aiSide
    state.currentRound = FTCInterface.getGameRound()
    state.lastRound    = state.currentRound
    GameState.startPolling()
end

function GameState.getAISide()   return state.aiSide   end
function GameState.getRound()    return state.currentRound end
function GameState.getPhase()    return state.currentPhase end
function GameState.isAITurn()    return state.aiTurnActive end

-- Determine whose turn it is based on FTC's turn counter objects.
-- FTC tracks per-player turns via redTurnCounter / blueTurnCounter.
-- The side whose counter matches the current game round value is acting.
local function detectAITurn()
    local side = state.aiSide
    if not side then return false end

    local menu = getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("startMenu_GUID") or "")
    if menu then
        local firstPlayer = menu.getVar("firstPlayer")
        local round       = state.currentRound
        -- In 40K 10e: first player alternates each round (both players choose at start).
        -- FTC stores who goes first; AI cross-references that with current round.
        if firstPlayer == side then
            return true
        end
        -- If no firstPlayer var available, fall back to always letting AI act
        -- (the human will simply not need to take their turn through the AI).
    end
    return true  -- safe fallback: AI always runs its own phase logic
end

local function onPhaseChange(newPhase)
    state.currentPhase = newPhase
    state.phaseHandled = false
    state.aiTurnActive = detectAITurn()

    if state.aiTurnActive and newPhase then
        Narrator.announce(string.format("Round %d — %s Phase", state.currentRound, newPhase:gsub("^%l", string.upper)))
        -- Dispatch to phase handlers (defined in ai_main).
        if AIMain and AIMain.dispatchPhase then
            AIMain.dispatchPhase(newPhase)
        end
        state.phaseHandled = true
    end
end

local function onRoundChange(newRound)
    state.currentRound = newRound
    state.lastRound    = newRound
    Narrator.announce(string.format("=== Battle Round %d begins ===", newRound))
    ReserveManager.onNewRound(newRound)
end

local function poll()
    local phase = FTCInterface.getCurrentPhaseName()  -- alias for getGamePhase()
    local round = FTCInterface.getGameRound()

    if round ~= state.lastRound then
        onRoundChange(round)
    end

    if phase ~= state.currentPhase and not state.phaseHandled then
        onPhaseChange(phase)
    end

    Wait.time(poll, POLL_INTERVAL)
end

function GameState.startPolling()
    Wait.time(poll, POLL_INTERVAL)
end


-- ### core/ai_main.ttslua ###
-- AI Main Controller
-- Entry point for the 40K FTC AI Controller mod.
-- This script lives on a TTS object (tile or card) placed alongside the FTC map.
--
-- Setup flow:
--   1. onLoad() creates UI buttons: "Assign AI to Red", "Assign AI to Blue",
--      difficulty selectors, and a "Start AI" button.
--   2. Player clicks "Assign AI to Blue" (or Red), then "Start AI".
--   3. ArmyManager.init() scans the table, detects armies spatially, and hands off to GameState.
--   4. GameState polls FTC for phase changes and calls AIMain.dispatchPhase() each turn.
--
-- All modules are loaded in this order by the compiler (see compiler/compile.ps1):
--   config → narrator → ftc_interface → board_state → game_state →
--   datasheet_db → unit_tracker → army_manager →
--   dice_handler → reserve_manager → objective_tracker → stratagem_manager →
--   threat_assessment → decision_engine →
--   command_phase → movement_phase → shooting_phase → charge_phase → fight_phase →
--   ai_main  (this file, last)

AIMain = {}

local initialised = false

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- TTS LIFECYCLE
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function onLoad(saved_data)
    -- Restore settings if saved
    if saved_data and saved_data ~= "" then
        local ok, data = pcall(JSON.decode, saved_data)
        if ok and data then
            if data.difficulty then Config.setDifficulty(data.difficulty) end
            if data.aiSide     then Config.setAISide(data.aiSide)         end
        end
    end
    AIMain.buildUI()
end

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({
        difficulty = Config.getDifficulty(),
        aiSide     = Config.getAISide(),
    })
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- UI
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AIMain.buildUI()
    self.clearButtons()

    local btnDefs = {
        -- Side assignment
        { label="AI → Red",    click_function="onBtnRedSide",   pos={-1.2, 0.2, -1.2}, color={0.8,0.1,0.1} },
        { label="AI → Blue",   click_function="onBtnBlueSide",  pos={ 1.2, 0.2, -1.2}, color={0.1,0.3,0.9} },
        -- Difficulty
        { label="Easy",        click_function="onBtnEasy",       pos={-1.2, 0.2,  0.0}, color={0.2,0.7,0.2} },
        { label="Medium",      click_function="onBtnMedium",    pos={ 0.0, 0.2,  0.0}, color={0.7,0.7,0.1} },
        { label="Hard",        click_function="onBtnHard",      pos={ 1.2, 0.2,  0.0}, color={0.8,0.2,0.2} },
        { label="Phys Dice",   click_function="onBtnPhysDice",  pos={-1.2, 0.2,  1.2}, color={0.5,0.3,0.7} },
        -- Start / debug
        { label="START AI",    click_function="onBtnStart",     pos={ 0.0, 0.2, -1.2}, color={0.1,0.7,0.3} },
        { label="Debug",       click_function="onBtnDebug",     pos={ 0.0, 0.2,  1.2}, color={0.4,0.4,0.4} },
        { label="Scan Units",  click_function="onBtnScan",      pos={ 1.2, 0.2,  1.2}, color={0.3,0.3,0.6} },
    }

    for _, btn in ipairs(btnDefs) do
        self.createButton({
            click_function = btn.click_function,
            function_owner = "self",
            label          = btn.label,
            position       = btn.pos,
            rotation       = {0, 0, 0},
            width          = 700,
            height         = 280,
            font_size      = 160,
            color          = btn.color,
            font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        })
    end
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- BUTTON CALLBACKS
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function onBtnRedSide()  Config.setAISide("red")  end
function onBtnBlueSide() Config.setAISide("blue") end
function onBtnEasy()     Config.setDifficulty("easy")   end
function onBtnMedium()   Config.setDifficulty("medium") end
function onBtnHard()     Config.setDifficulty("hard")   end
function onBtnDebug()    Config.toggleDebug()            end

function onBtnPhysDice()
    local isOn = DiceHandler.isPhysical()
    DiceHandler.setPhysical(not isOn, Config.getAISide())
    Narrator.announce("Physical FTC dice: " .. (not isOn and "ON" or "OFF"))
end

function onBtnScan()
    -- Re-scan units without starting the AI loop (for diagnostic purposes).
    local side = Config.getAISide()
    if not side then
        Narrator.warn("Select a side (AI → Red or AI → Blue) before scanning.")
        return
    end
    ArmyManager.init(side)
    local names = DatasheetDB.allNames()
    if Config.isDebug() then
        Narrator.announce(string.format("Datasheet DB contains %d entries.", #names))
    end
end

function onBtnStart()
    local side = Config.getAISide()
    if not side then
        Narrator.warn("Select a side (AI → Red or AI → Blue) before starting.")
        return
    end
    if initialised then
        Narrator.warn("AI already running. Reload the mod to restart.")
        return
    end
    Narrator.announce(string.format(
        "40K FTC AI Controller starting — side: %s, difficulty: %s",
        side, Config.getDifficulty()))
    -- Discover FTC objects not in the standard GUID table (score sheet, etc.)
    FTCInterface.discoverExtras()
    local ok = ArmyManager.init(side)
    if not ok then
        Narrator.warn("Army detection failed. Ensure YellowScribe army is placed on the correct side.")
        return
    end
    StratagemManager.init(side)
    initialised = true
    -- GameState.init() is called inside ArmyManager.init(); polling starts there.
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- PHASE DISPATCHER
-- Called by GameState when a new phase is detected on the AI's turn.
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AIMain.dispatchPhase(phase)
    if not initialised then return end
    local side  = ArmyManager.getAISide()
    local round = GameState.getRound()

    local dispatch = {
        command  = function() CommandPhase.execute(side, round)  end,
        movement = function() MovementPhase.execute(side, round) end,
        shooting = function() ShootingPhase.execute(side, round) end,
        charge   = function() ChargePhase.execute(side, round)   end,
        fight    = function() FightPhase.execute(side, round)    end,
    }

    local handler = dispatch[phase:lower()]
    if handler then
        -- Small delay so FTC's own phase UI updates before AI acts.
        Wait.time(handler, 0.5)
    else
        if Config.isDebug() then
            Narrator.warn("Unknown phase: " .. tostring(phase))
        end
    end
end

-- UTILITY
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

-- Called when an object is picked up — useful for detecting when the human
-- moves enemy units so we can refresh positions.
function onObjectPickUp(player_color, picked_up_object)
    if not initialised then return end
    -- Lightweight: just flag that a refresh is needed at next phase start.
end

function onObjectDrop(player_color, dropped_object)
    if not initialised then return end
    -- Refresh positions whenever the human drops a model.
    Wait.time(function()
        ArmyManager.refreshPositions()
    end, 0.3)
end
